views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId,
  c.FirstName,
  ii.InvoiceId,
  ii.InvoiceLineId,
  ii.TrackId,
  ii.UnitPrice,
  ii.Quantity,
  (ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS LineAmount,
  t.AlbumId,
  a.ArtistId,
  ar.Name AS ArtistName
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
JOIN artists ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
views.description:
Task: Find the first names of customers and the amounts they spent on albums by the best-selling artist, but only include customers whose total spending on that artist's albums is less than $1.
